title: Working Student Operations
description:
**About lemon.markets**

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

**Your Mission:**

As our Operations Working Student, you will support the day-to-day processes that keep our investing products and customer operations running smoothly. Your work will include instrument management, trading monitoring, regulatory and operational tasks, as well as customer onboarding, account changes, and partner requests. You will work with experienced colleagues, learn how the securities lifecycle and customer operations work in practice, and take ownership of clearly scoped tasks as you grow into the role.

You’ll collaborate with colleagues across Securities Operations, Market Operations, Customer Operations, Product, Engineering, and Compliance to help create a reliable end-to-end experience for partners and customers. Expect hands-on learning, varied tasks, and the opportunity to improve how we work, without being expected to arrive as a securities or regulatory expert.

You will support our daily Investing and Customer Operations, help investigate issues, and contribute to making our processes more reliable and efficient.

  

**In this role you will support with:**

* **Trading Monitoring:** Support daily checks of trading activity and operational workflows. Spot unusual activity, failed or rejceted orders, and data discrepancies; help investigate them and escalate findings.
* **Regulatory Checks & Controls:** Help prepare data, maintain documentation and evidence, and track recurring regulatory and compliance-related tasks. Work closely with the responsible specialists to make sure follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
* **Cross-Functional Topics:** Support projects and day-to-day questions involving Investing Operations, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and other Operations teams - for example, by testing process changes, gathering information, or coordinating open items.
* **Process Improvement & Quality Assurance:** Identify opportunities to improve day-to-day workflows, help turn ideas into practical process changes, and keep operational documentation up to date.
* **Partner Support & Customer Operations:** Help process partner requests relating to their customers, including account requests and customer-data changes, and route more complex cases to the right colleagues.
* **KYC Operations & Quality Assurance:** Support identity-verification workflows, record checks accurately, and help review operational work so our customer processes remain dependable and compliant.

**You will be successful in this role if:**

* You are currently enrolled at a German university in business administration, economics, operations, or a similar degree program, and will remain enrolled for at least one more year.
* You are curious about investing, financial markets, and how brokerage works. Some familiarity with financial products / operational processes or some first work experience in this area is a plus.
* You work carefully and in a structured way: you pay attention to details, keep track of open items, and understand why accuracy matters in a regulated environment.
* You are reliable and take ownership of your tasks. You follow through, ask questions when something is unclear, and flag issues early rather than making assumptions.
* You bring a learning and growth mindset. You enjoy getting to know new tools and processes, welcome feedback, and are comfortable adapting when priorities change.
* You have a hands-on, collaborative approach and enjoy working with people across different teams to find practical solutions.
* You are based in Berlin and available to work in a hybrid setup with regular time in the office.

**How we take care of you:**

* **Compensation package:** Our working student positions are compensated at a fixed rate of €15-17 per hour.
* **Make a real impact:** Our start-up environment gives you the room to start your career, explore areas outside your role, and build expertise through ownership. As we mature and are backed by dwpbank, we’re adding a layer of resources and expertise you are benefiting from.
* **Flexible working hours:** We know your studies come first. That’s why we offer flexible hours that adapt to your class schedule and exam periods, so you can plan your work time around your semester.
* **Hybrid work setup:** You can work from Berlin within a hybrid model. That being said, we encourage our working student lemoneers to come to the office regularly. Being on-site allows you to learn faster, provides a more immersive experience, helps you collaborate more effectively with the team, and ensures you fully benefit from hands-on support.
* **Grow with us:** We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, plus a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations so you always know where you stand, and what to do to level up.
* **People & culture:** You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.
* **Workation:** Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

You have any questions? Feel free to contact us via talent@lemon.markets
why_fits: Strong Business & Data Operations fit. Matches keywords: ai, workflow, api, git, documentation, cross-functional.

selected_bullets: Designed and built an internal AI Conversation QA & Evaluation web tool featuring automated workflows and bulk-review evaluation pipelines, enabling agents to audit and benchmark AI quality significantly faster.

Developed an automated Price-Lead Offer Email tool integrating internal admin systems, REST APIs, and low-code automation workflows to extract customer data and auto-generate personalized offer emails.
Implemented, structured, and maintained an AI chatbot, custom databases, and AI knowledge / vector databases, overseeing deployment and retrieval improvements handling 30,000+ monthly conversations.

Created a real-time cross-country collaboration knowledge base enabling live cross-border agent support during customer calls (e.g., Netherlands agents assisting Belgium operations in real time), standardizing multi-market workflows.

Performed quantitative analysis on complex, unstructured multi-market datasets using SQL (Redash) and Advanced Excel, building automated company-wide KPI reporting and dashboards in collaboration with 3 project managers.

Built a centralized Google Reviews & Trustpilot management web portal (versioned via Git/GitHub) with template-based smart reply suggestions, turning manual review discovery into a one-click approval workflow.
cover_letter_paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Working Student Operations role at lemon.markets. Through my experience helping scale conversational AI tools, optimizing operational workflows, and building data-driven internal products at Auto1 Group, I have learned that the greatest value comes from combining analytical rigor with practical builder execution. With a Bachelor's degree in Digital Product Management and my ongoing Master's studies in International Business Management in Berlin, I am eager to contribute this hands-on, problem-solving mindset to your team.

In my current role as a Junior Project Manager at Auto1 Group in Berlin, I work closely with product managers, developers, and regional operations leads across nine European markets. My key initiatives include optimizing an international AI voice bot that scaled to route millions of calls (raising inbound answer rates from 65% to 85%), as well as structuring retrieval knowledge bases for an AI chatbot handling 30,000+ monthly customer chats. To empower operational teams, I built an automated multi-market knowledge base, an AI QA review web application, and API-driven customer communication tools.

Beyond day-to-day operations, I genuinely enjoy untangling disorganized datasets and creating solutions that make teams more efficient. In my analytics and reporting work, I frequently write SQL queries in Redash and build dashboards across Excel, Tableau, and Looker Studio so stakeholders have dependable, real-time metrics. When off-the-shelf software falls short, I roll up my sleeves to build lightweight internal tools, whether that means connecting internal systems through REST APIs, automating multi-step workflows, or testing and structuring custom evaluation data. Collaborating in an international Berlin environment has also allowed me to work comfortably across languages, using my native Spanish, fluent English, and working German (B1).

What particularly excites me about lemon.markets is the opportunity to bring this mix of analytical curiosity and builder execution to your team. Thank you very much for taking the time to review my application. I would welcome the chance to speak with you and discuss how my background can support lemon.markets in this role.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Digitalisierung & KI im Sales Support Team (SST)
description:
**Unsere Mission**
HEINEKEN - das ist mehr als nur ein Getränk, es ist ein globales Symbol für Qualität, Leidenschaft und den Geschmack des Lebens. Es ist ein Erlebnis, ein Stück urbane Kultur und ein Statement für Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit. Wir sind eine Gemeinschaft aus unterschiedlichsten Charakteren. Unsere Biere sind so vielfältig wie die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. Wir glauben an die Kraft des Zusammenseins und daran, dass die besten Geschichten oft mit einem kühlen Heineken, Desperados oder Gösser beginnen. Als Teil der globalen HEINEKEN-Familie stehen wir für höchste Qualität, nachhaltige Braukunst und unvergessliche Momente. Um unsere Erfolgsgeschichte in der Zukunft von HEINEKEN Deutschland weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
**für zwölf Monate**
als
  
  
**Werkstudent (m/w/d) Digitalisierung & KI im Sales Support Team (SST)**
**Deine Mission**
Das machst du bei uns:
  
  
Du möchtest Digitalisierung nicht nur begleiten, sondern aktiv vorantreiben? Dann werde Teil unseres Sales Support Teams und unterstütze uns auf dem Weg von einer operativen Supportfunktion hin zu einer modernen, datengetriebenen und digital unterstützten Serviceorganisation. Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und KI sind dabei wesentliche Erfolgsfaktoren. Als Werkstudent:in arbeitest Du an innovativen Projekten rund um Prozessdigitalisierung, künstliche Intelligenz und moderne Microsoft-Technologien und hilfst dabei, innovative Lösungen in die Praxis zu bringen. So trägst Du dazu bei, unsere operativen Prozesse effizienter, transparenter und skalierbarer zu gestalten.
  
  
Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf strategischen Transformationsprojekten wie der Einführung eines zentralen Ticket-Management-Systems sowie der Identifikation und Umsetzung von KI-Anwendungsfällen im Vertriebs- und Supportumfeld.
  
  
Im Detail heißt das:
  
  

* Unterstützung bei der Digitalisierung und Optimierung von SST-Prozessen
* Mitarbeit bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung eines zentralen Ticket-Management-Systems für Sales Support
* Identifikation, Bewertung und Umsetzung von KI- und Automatisierungspotenzialen
* Aufbau und Pflege von Power Apps, Power Automate Workflows und anderen Microsoft-365-Lösungen
* Erstellung von Dashboards, Reports und Analysen mit Power BI
* Unterstützung bei der Einführung neuer digitaler Tools und Arbeitsweisen
* Durchführung von Tests, Dokumentationen und Schulungsunterlagen
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit SST, Sales, D&T, CS sowie weiteren Fachbereichen
* Recherche zu neuesten Entwicklungen und Best Practices im Bereich KI, Digitalisierung und Automatisierung
* Unterstützung bei Change- und Transformationsprojekten innerhalb von SST

**Das wünschen wir uns von dir:**

* Laufendes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science, BWL mit Schwerpunkt Digitalisierung oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
* Interesse an Digitalisierung, Prozessoptimierung und Künstlicher Intelligenz
* Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Power BI oder vergleichbaren digitalen Lösungen
* Analytische und strukturierte Denkweise
* Selbstständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise
* Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern
* Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

**Was wir dir bieten:**

* Work & Play / Arbeitsfreude & Teamspirit: Ein wertschätzendes Team, das zusammenhält, Erfolge feiert und Spaß an der Arbeit hat.
* Time off / Freizeit und Flexibilität: Sonderurlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten für mehr Balance
* Shape the future / deine Ideen bewegen uns: Deine Ideen zählen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen umzusetzen und die Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten
* Grow with us / Entwickle dein Potenzial: Vielfältige Weiterbildungsangebote für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung
* Health first / Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen. Wir legen viel Wert auf die Themen Health, Well-Being & Sicherheit am Arbeitsplatz bzw. in deinem Dienstwagen
* Benefits / weil mehr drin sein sollte: über 40,00 € monatliches Benefits-Guthaben, Zuschuss zum ÖPNV und zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge über den Mindestzuschuss hinaus sowie Sonderkonditionen bei Urban Sports Club als auch Vorteile durch Corporate Benefits bis hin zum Bike Leasing und modernster IT-Ausstattung: Wir bieten dir attraktive Extras, die deinen Alltag erleichtern und deine Zukunft stärken

**Warum du dich für uns entscheiden solltest:**
Weil wir lieben, was wir tun. Weil wir jeden Tag aufs Neue mit Leidenschaft und Kreativität an die Arbeit gehen. Bei uns bekommst du nicht nur ein Produkt, sondern ein Stück urbanes Lebensgefühl. HEINEKEN – das ist mehr als nur ein Bier. Das ist Geschichte, das ist Gemeinschaft, das ist der Geschmack des Lebens. Wir feiern das Leben, die Freundschaften und die unvergesslichen Momente, die uns verbinden. Von legendären Musikfestivals, über die Champions-League, bis hin zu exklusiven Events in deiner Stadt – bei uns ist immer was los. Vielleicht bist auch du bald ein Teil von HEINEKEN Deutschland? Wir sind gespannt auf deine Abenteuer und freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
  
  
**Kontakt**
HEINEKEN Deutschland GmbH
  
  
Human Resources Team
  
  
Ehrenbergstraße 19
  
  
10245 Berlin

title: Working Student - Product & Project Management (all genders)
description:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As a Working Student in Product & Project Management for most of your time, you run projects with our partners and internal teams from first request to done. When there's time, you work on data projects. You work closely with the Head of Product and see up close how product decisions get made.
  
  
This is a 20h/week hybrid role, with 1 day per week working from our Berlin office.

  
  
**Requirements**  

### **Your Mission**

* Check and triage new requests from partners and internal teams on our Jira board: what is it, how urgent is it, and who owns it?

* Clarify requirements with stakeholders and turn them into clear tickets for our product squads
* Find the right people (Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Legal) and bring them together
* Answer questions yourself where you can; check reported bugs yourself and test fixes before they go live
* Track every project until it's closed, and send a short regular status update to stakeholders
* Help us organise how feature requests from internal teams are collected, tracked and made visible to the product managers
* Prepare priority calls and escalations for the Head of Product
* Build and maintain dashboards for our product KPIs
* Run analyses for the product team, e.g. how a KPI changed before and after a release
* Tools you will work with: Jira, Confluence, Slack, Google Workspace, Metabase / SQL

### **What You Will Need to Succeed**

* Enrolled at a university (working student status), available 20 h/week for at least 12 months

* German at B2 level or higher, plus good English. Many of our partners and stakeholders work in German.
* Strong analytical thinking and a record of excellent results (grades, scholarships, projects, competitions)
* Technical affinity: you understand how web apps, APIs and data flows work, or you learn fast. An error message or a data table doesn't scare you.
* Structured and reliable: you keep many threads open without dropping one, and you follow up without being asked
* Clear writing, and confidence with experienced stakeholders

### **What Would Make You Stand Out**

* First experience in product management, consulting, a startup or project coordination
* SQL skills
* Experience building with AI or automation tools (n8n, Zapier, LLM APIs)
Interest in insurance, health or insurtech  

  
  
**Benefits**

**Why getolo?**

**Vacation**

* Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st. Vacation entitlement for working students is prorated based on working days per week

‍ **Mobility & Flexibility**

* Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte

**Health**

* Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
* Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

**Development**

* Regular (360 degree) feedback

**Berlin Based, International Mindset**

* We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
* Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

**Values**

* Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:
* + #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes
  + #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction
  + #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions
  + #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive

**And much more…**

* Legendary summer and winter parties
* Regular team events
* Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform
* Two Community Days per calendar year
* Pet friendly office

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

**About getolo**

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.  
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.  
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany.

getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our team members, regardless of ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations and talents of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

When you apply, we focus solely on your experience and motivation. You decide what additional information you want to disclose (photo, marital status, religion, gender, nationality, etc.). We value and treat all applications equally.

Contact:

getolo Recruiting Team  
jobs@getolo.com

description:

Hello there! We're Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we're now humbled to call the world our playground, with over **260 employees** spread across **13 countries** (we're remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from **+190 markets,** globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement?

Here at Appinio, we value **transparency** **in our recruitment process**, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together:**here**

**Your mission as a Working Student - Product Operations**

We are looking for a **Working Student - Product Operations (m/f/d)** to support the daily operations of the Appinio mobile app and help ensure a smooth, high-quality user experience.

Working closely with our Product Management team, you will help identify and resolve user issues, monitor app quality, and support community operations. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in Product Operations while contributing to a mobile product used by a global community.

**What you will be doing**

* **User Support & Issue Management:** Review and manage incoming support tickets from the Appinio app help center. Understand, categorize, and prioritize user-reported issues, validate them by reproducing bugs, and check whether they are genuine, urgent, or already known. Escalate to Product Managers when needed.
* **App Quality Monitoring:** Perform daily quality checks of the mobile app to ensure key user flows are working properly.
* **Community Operations:** Perform manual checks related to community operations, including user bans and related review tasks, based on internal guidelines.
* **Insights & Prioritization Input:** Identify patterns in support requests and monitor recurring user pain points. Highlight them to Product Managers so they feed into product prioritization.
* **Documentation & Collaboration:** Document findings clearly and maintain internal tracking of bugs, incidents, and quality issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Development and Quality Assurance.

**You will thrive in this role if**

* You are currently enrolled at a university and have **at least 1 year of studies remaining.**
* You have a strong interest in mobile apps, product management, product operations, and user experience, along with a good understanding of mobile applications and common user issues.
* You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to work through tasks in a structured way. You are comfortable handling operational tasks, recurring processes, and repetitive work while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* You have strong communication skills and can clearly describe issues and observations.
* You are proactive, reliable, and have a high sense of ownership. You can identify what is important and urgent and are comfortable making judgment calls within clear guidelines.
* You have ideally gained some initial experience in customer support, manual app testing and bug reproduction, mobile app operations, quality assurance, or product-related work.
* You have ideally worked with spreadsheets or reporting tools to track operational work and issues.
* You are based in Germany

**What's in it for you?**

* Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location.

**Kind reminder:** Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

*This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm.*

*Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.*

**Your Tasks**
==============

* **Online Product Launches:** Supporting our online product launches, tracking timelines, and ensuring product information is accurate and up to date.
* **Catalog & Assortment Management:** Managing our product assortment and catalog, overseeing product categorization, avoiding SKU duplication, and maintaining a clean, logical assortment structure.

* **E-Commerce Projects & Website Maintenance:** Supporting e-commerce projects, tests, and ongoing website maintenance initiatives.
* **KPI Monitoring & Reporting:** Assisting with KPI monitoring, reporting, and website analysis to help identify growth opportunities.

**Your Profile**
================

* **Studies & Motivation:** Enrolled student with curiosity, motivation, and a genuine interest in start-ups, e-commerce, and digital marketing.
* **Project Management:** Strong project management skills with enthusiasm for organizing projects and working with digital tools.
* **Analytical Skills:** Proficient in Google Sheets and MS Excel.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Experience with Notion; previous hands-on experience with Shopware or Hygraph is a strong plus.
* **Work Style:** Strong communication skills, excellent organization, and a results-driven mindset.
* **Languages:** Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

**What you can expect from us**
===============================

* **Smart Working & Flexibility:** Hybrid work and flexible hours that fit perfectly around your lecture schedule or exam periods. No making coffee or endless photocopying here – we trust you with real ownership from day one.
* **Growth & Onboarding:** You are a fully integrated team member! With your ideas, you can actively shape the future of the food retail industry in a fast-growing scale-up. You’ll receive a structured onboarding and your own MacBook for your time with us.
* **KoRo Life & Extras:** Find your way (back) to the gym thanks to our fitness partnerships like Urban Sports Club or FitX. You’ll also get a 20% discount in our KoRo online store and exclusive perks with partner companies. Plus, free snacks and barista coffee are always waiting for you at the office!
* **Shared Moments:** Regular team events and company parties to celebrate our milestones and successes together.

**We're looking for People who share our Mindset**
==================================================

For us, it's not just about the *what*, but above all about the *how*. You'll be a perfect fit for us if you have the following mindset:

* **You take initiative and ownership.** You don't wait for a perfect brief or a mandate to get started. When you see an opportunity, a risk, or something that can be improved - you act. When things don't go as planned, you look at your own contribution first and step up, without waiting to be asked.
* **You thrive in change.** Shifting priorities and evolving processes don't slow you down. You adapt fast and keep moving.
* **You build, you don't wait.** When something is missing - a tool, a process, a solution - you create it. You prefer a working MVP over a perfect plan and iterate from there.
* **You think in leverage.** You question how things are done, prioritize ruthlessly, and find smarter paths to better outcomes. You don't mistake effort for impact.
* **You're a team player, humble and genuinely kind.** You collaborate in and across teams, care about the people around you, and bring sparkles to the room. You speak up when you disagree, commit fully once a decision is made, and actively make the people around you better.

***Own it – Move fast – Build it – Create impact – Lift others***

**Sounds good?**
================

Then we’d love to hear from you! Send us your **CV** and tell us a little about yourself in a few introductory sentences – who you are, what drives you, and why you’d like to become part of KoRo. After all, we’re looking for team members, not just co-workers!

**The KoRo team is just as diverse as our product range!** We want to keep it that way as our nut-loving team grows. That’s why we welcome all applicants regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity.

Ready to join KoRo? **We look forward to hearing from you!**

title: Working Student (m/f/d) Research & Development in Secure and Trustworthy AI
description:
**Working Student (m/f/d) Research & Development in Secure and Trustworthy AI**
===============================================================================

Join secunet’s research and technology innovation team at the earliest opportunity. Within our core technology field of Secure and Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence, you will help explore how to build secure and trustworthy AI infrastructures and services—and demonstrate that they meet defined security and reliability requirements. Our focus is on large language models (LLMs) and AI agents.

**Your Tasks**
--------------

You will contribute to research and development projects, explore new ideas and learn from experienced colleagues. Depending on your interests and experience, your responsibilities will include:

* Investigating security and assurance methods for LLMs and AI agents, including guardrails, runtime verification, sandboxing, prompt injection mitigation, formal methods and agent identities
* Evaluating emerging technologies and developing approaches to assess and substantiate their security and reliability
* Building prototypes to assess feasibility and test assumptions
* Contributing to research projects with academic and technology partners
* Helping transfer promising research results into our product and service units
* Documenting findings and contributing to security guidelines and reference architectures

You will work with NixOS as our Linux operating system, Rust for the components we develop, Nix for declarative builds and dependency management, and GitLab as our development platform.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* You are currently enrolled in a master’s programme in computer science or a related field
* You have practical programming experience and are keen to learn our technology stack
* You are interested in research at the intersection of AI, systems security and assurance
* You enjoy exploring emerging technologies and approaching new challenges with curiosity
* You work independently and systematically and enjoy collaborating with others
* You are proficient in English; German language skills are a plus
* Ideally, you have hands-on experience with LLM systems, Rust, Linux, Nix or Kubernetes
* An understanding of IT security, software verification or systematic testing would be an advantage

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Team spirit:** Work with colleagues who support each other and tackle challenging projects together.
* **Meaningful work:** Contribute to IT security solutions that make a difference.
* **Individual development:** Develop your skills with support tailored to your interests and goals.
* **People first:** Join a workplace that values diversity, mutual respect and a healthy balance between work and personal life.
* **Flexible working:** Organise your working hours around your studies, with up to 20 hours per week.
* **Work from abroad:** Work remotely from another EU country for up to 20 days per year.
* **Additional benefits:** Enjoy corporate fitness, a discounted public transport ticket, secudog and more.
* **Attractive remuneration:** Your hourly rate reflects your qualifications, progress in your studies and relevant practical experience.

**Your Contact**
----------------

secunet Security Networks AG  
Beatrice Mungen  
Kurfürstenstraße 58  
45138 Essen  
  
Would you like to help shape the future of secure and trustworthy AI in an environment built on trust and fairness? We look forward to receiving your complete application, quoting reference **3540/A.**

title: Associate Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
**At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.**
Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for
**10,000+ businesses worldwide**
, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today,
**millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day**
.
  
  
We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.
  
  
We're
**100 people**
,
**profitable**
, and have raised
**€18M in funding**
(last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
  
  
We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.
  
  
In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.
  
  
We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.
  
  
Learn how product is built from the inside, working side by side with our CPO.
  
  
*As our Associate Product Manager, you'll work directly with our CPO as a force multiplier for the product team. You'll take on high-impact work across customer research, product data, product marketing and adoption - topics that span the whole product org rather than a single product area.*
Who We Want
  
  
**Hungry learner**
You're eager to learn fast, actively seek feedback and turn it into visible progress within weeks, not months.
  
  
**Structured self-starter**
You're highly organized, bring order to messy situations and get things done without step-by-step guidance.
  
  
**Analytical thinker**
You're comfortable with data and can pull numbers from spreadsheets or analytics tools and turn them into clear insights.
  
  
**Customer-curious**
You enjoy talking to users, ask good follow-up questions and turn interviews into actionable takeaways.
  
  
**Clear communicator**
You write crisply, build clean slides and feel comfortable presenting to customers, e.g. in webinars.
  
  
**Scrappy generalist**
You're happy to switch between product marketing, data, research and ops, and no task is "beneath you".
  
  
**AI-native**
You use AI tools daily to work faster and better - from research and data analysis to drafting content and slides - and you're always experimenting with new ones.
  
  
**Has taste**
You have a strong sense for what good looks like in product, design and writing, and you notice when something feels off, even if it's "technically fine".
  
  
**Language**
You're fluent in English, written and spoken.
  
  
Who We Don't Want
  
  

* You only want "pure PM" work like roadmaps and specs and aren't interested in marketing or customer-facing tasks
* You need a lot of structure and clear processes to be productive
* You struggle to communicate clearly in English, in writing or in front of an audience
* You get defensive when receiving feedback
* You see this mainly as a title step rather than a chance to learn and get hands-on

**Your Day to Day**
Strategic Projects (~25%)
  
  

* Work directly with our CPO on the topics that matter most right now
* Prepare leadership meetings, drive decisions forward and make sure priorities turn into results

Product Marketing & Launches (~35%)
  
  

* Plan and run initiatives that bring our product to customers: webinars, product updates, customer events, newsletters and educational content
* Prepare and launch new features end-to-end together with Product, Engineering and Marketing
* Build sharp slides and reports for customers and leadership

Customer Research (~20%)
  
  

* Run customer interviews and turn what you hear into clear insights for the product team
* Feed those insights into roadmap decisions together with our PMs

Product Analytics & Adoption (~20%)
  
  

* Own dashboards on activation and adoption and turn the numbers into actions
* Drive initiatives that improve activation and adoption of key features

**Stakeholders**
**Product Managers:**
Feed customer insights and data into roadmap decisions and support with research, specs and launch prep
  
  
**Engineering & Design:**
Clarify requirements, gather product feedback and coordinate release timing for launches
  
  
**Customer Success:**
Identify customers for interviews and work together on onboarding, activation and adoption initiatives
  
  
**Sales:**
Build enablement material and slides, and align on positioning and messaging for new features
  
  
**Marketing:**
Co-own product launches, webinars, release content and campaigns
  
  
**Customers:**
Run interviews and webinars, collect feedback and turn it into insights for the team
  
  
Why People Choose Us
  
  

* We believe in the power of in-person collaboration: We're an in-office culture at heart - we genuinely love being together in the Berlin office. That's where the best ideas happen, decisions move faster, and we learn from and grow with each other every day. We do offer some flexibility for remote work, but our default and our energy is being in the room together.
* We're an international team with diverse cultural backgrounds and languages. Openness, mutual respect, and the exchange of different perspectives shape the way we work together.
* We value ambition and drive. We're looking for people who take ownership, show initiative, and are excited to grow quickly.
* We work with a high degree of ownership and a strong learning mindset. Asking questions, staying curious, and continuously improving are part of our everyday culture.
* We care deeply about humility and teamwork. No egos, open feedback, and a willingness to learn from one another matter more to us than titles.

**Benefits & Culture**

* Choose between an Urban Sports Club or John Reed membership, or a public transport pass/Dance subscription.
* Regular company-wide and team events.
* An annual €500 learning and development budget that you can use for conferences, courses, books, career coaching, and more.
* An inclusive and exciting startup culture that supports rapid professional and personal growth.
* A beautiful office in the heart of Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) with free snacks, drinks, and top-notch equipment.

**We want to build a community, not just a company.**
Creating an environment where people genuinely enjoy spending time together is important to us - whether that's through HYROX training, golf, beer pong tournaments, running clubs, Warhammer, weekend activities, or any other community you'd like to build here.
  
  
**We believe that diversity makes companies stronger. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, background, nationality, or religion. Feel free to apply - we'd love to hear from you!**
**By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy.**
**We look forward to receiving your application! 🙂**

title: Werkstudent:in Sales Operations – KI, Automatisierung & Daten (d/m/w)
description:
Tagesspiegel Impact vermarktet die Werbelösungen des Tagesspiegels in Print und Digital. Damit sich unsere Verkaufsteams auf ihre Kund:innen konzentrieren können, sorgt das Team Sales Operations für verlässliche Daten, gute Prozesse und Tools, die Arbeit abnehmen. Genau hier steigst Du ein.
  
  
Bei uns bekommst Du keine Daueraufgabe. Du übernimmst eigene kleine Projekte, die echte Probleme im Arbeitsalltag lösen. Drei Beispiele, wie das aussehen kann:
  
  

* Formular statt Mail-Pingpong: Anfragen an ein Team laufen bisher per Mail und gehen unter. Du klärst mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, welche Angaben sie brauchen. Dann baust Du ein Formular in Jotform und sorgst dafür, dass jede Anfrage automatisch bei den richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen landet.
* Erste Automatisierung mit KI: Du testest in Langdock (unsere KI-Plattform, über die wir Sprachmodelle wie GPT oder Claude nutzen), wie sich eine wiederkehrende Aufgabe automatisieren lässt, etwa das Zusammenfassen von Kund:inneninformationen. Daraus baust Du einen ersten Prototyp.
* Analyse für eine Entscheidung: Du führst Daten aus mehreren Quellen in Excel zusammen und bereitest sie so auf, dass eine konkrete Frage klar beantwortet werden kann.

**Das sind Deine Aufgaben:**

* Du setzt eigene kleine Projekte um: Bedarf verstehen, Lösung bauen, testen, übergeben
* Du baust Formulare und einfache Abläufe in Jotform
* Du probierst KI-Anwendungen in Langdock aus und entwickelst erste Automatisierungen
* Du bereitest Daten in Excel auf und verknüpfst Tabellen, z. B. mit XVERWEIS
* Du arbeitest Dich in neue Tools ein, sobald wir sie brauchen
* Du dokumentierst Deine Lösungen so, dass andere damit weiterarbeiten können

**Das bringst Du mit:**

* Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einem ähnlichen Fach. Du studierst etwas ganz anderes? Bewirb Dich trotzdem. Bei uns haben schon Leute aus sehr unterschiedlichen Studiengängen richtig gut gepasst
* Du tüftelst gern und legst auch ohne fertige Anleitung los
* Ein neues Tool ist für Dich eine Einladung, kein Hindernis
* Du kannst sicher mit Excel umgehen und Tabellen verknüpfen
* Erste Erfahrung mit KI-Tools, No-Code-Tools oder Automatisierung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss
* Du sprichst sicher Deutsch, denn Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Verkaufsteams zusammen

**Das bieten wir Dir:**

* Verantwortung für eigene Projekte statt reiner Zuarbeit
* Einblicke in Vermarktung, CRM, Daten und den Einsatz von KI in einem Medienhaus
* Kontinuierliches, ehrliches Feedback, damit Du schnell wächst
* Ein klares Gefühl dafür, welche Arbeit dir liegt – eine gute Grundlage für die Zeit nach dem Studium
* Kreativer Freiraum in einem Team, in dem Ideen geschätzt werden und Du Deine Visionen in einem innovativen Medienunternehmen im Herzen Berlins umsetzen kannst
* Flache Hierarchien mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Kommunikation
* Bezuschusstes BVG-Firmenticket und Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
* Kostenloses Digital-Abonnement von Tagesspiegel & Tagesspiegel Plus, Handelsblatt und die Zeit
* Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch die Online-Plattform Masterplan, um Deine Karriere voranzutreiben
* 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer Vollzeitstelle), damit Du ausreichend Zeit hast, um Dich zu erholen
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten bis zu 50%

Jede Nachricht erzählt eine eigene Geschichte – und so ist es auch mit den Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. Beim Tagesspiegel schätzen wir die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter und sind fest davon überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven unsere Arbeit bereichern.
  
  
Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und fördern einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter oder sexueller Identität – bei uns bist Du willkommen. Lass uns gemeinsam ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld schaffen, in dem jeder seine Einzigartigkeit einbringen kann!
  
  
**Du denkst, wir sollten uns kennenlernen?**
Wenn Du bereit bist, Deine Fähigkeiten in einem inspirierenden Team einzusetzen und einen echten Unterschied zu machen, dann bewirb Dich jetzt über unser Bewerbungsportal
**https://verlagsjobs.tagesspiegel.de/**
und sende uns Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen. Gemeinsam erzählen wir Geschichten, die bewegen!
  
  
**Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!**

title: Customer Support NL/ENG - Working Student
description:
**At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.**

**Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.**

As a Working Student in Customer Support, you will be the first point of contact for Dutch and English-speaking customers, helping them get the most out of Moss via live chat, email and phone. It is a hands-on role where you build real support experience in a fintech product.

You will report to the Team Lead Customer Support and work directly with the Berlin support team. What you learn from customers feeds back into how the team works, so your input shapes the support experience. The role comes with the potential for a permanent position.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Respond to customer inquiries in Dutch and English across live chat, email and phone, giving accurate answers quickly
* Own customer queries from first contact through to resolution
* Work directly with the Berlin support team to troubleshoot complex account issues
* Guide new corporate users through the web and mobile app, pointing them to self-service resources and documentation
* Share customer feedback with the team and contribute to improving internal support processes

**About you**
-------------

* Initial experience in customer support, client services, or another user-facing role
* Business-fluent English (C1/C2) and Dutch (native or C1+)
* Experience in fintech, SaaS or banking is a plus
* Interested in a long-term path at Moss

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

* Solves customer problems efficiently and with empathy
* Adapts tone to different customer personalities and stays calm in stressful conversations
* Picks up new software, CRM tools (such as Zendesk or Salesforce) and internal workflows quickly
* Writes and speaks clearly, in both Dutch and English
* Reliable and comfortable working as part of an onsite team

**About Moss**

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's **what else to expect:**

* Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.
* Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.
* Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

*Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).*

***By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our*** ***Data Privacy Policy******.***

title: People & Culture - Working Student (all genders)
description:
**About us**
------------

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

**Your Role**
-------------

Do you want to drive turn everyday People administration into a seamless, high-quality experience for every single employee?

Are you ready to support both the operational engine and the talent growth of a fast-paced tech scale-up?

If you are a detail-oriented student who loves supporting people and keeping processes sharp by bringing employees and business needs together, **then you are our perfect match!**

Expect a steep learning curve, with experienced colleagues by your side. You will gain deep in-depth knowledge of the entire employee life cycle, from initial recruitment to the final stage of a successful career.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Support People Admin:** You help our People Operations with everyday employee inquiries, such as holidays, workations and learning budgets, and you keep our Jira Service Management tickets moving with speed and care.
* **Help Keep Data Accurate:** You support the maintenance of employee master data and digital personal files, following clear guidelines, so that everything stays accurate and up to date.
* **Document Support:** You prepare employment certificates, reference letters and other essential HR documents in German and English.
* **Talent Spotlight:** You help us look after the perfect candidate, from the first review of applications for junior roles to taking notes in interviews, so that the experience stays world-class.
* **Process Coordination:** You help the recruiting process run smoothly by scheduling interviews and following up with stakeholders to keep the momentum high.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

**Experience**

* You are currently enrolled and studying Business Administration, Human Resources Management, Psychology, or a related subject.
* Initial experience in fast-paced companies or HR environment is a plus.
* Experience in a Tech Scale-up environment is a bonus.

**Skills**

* **Bilingual Proficiency:** You speak and write German and English at a professional level (C1/Native).
* **Organizational Talent:** You can juggle multiple tasks and projects without losing your cool or your attention to detail.
* **Tech Savvy:** You are comfortable (or eager to learn) working with tools like Personio, Leapsome, Jira, and Google Workspace.

**Mindset**

* **Detail Lover:** Accuracy is your quiet superpower.
* **Discreet & Trustworthy:** You handle sensitive data with care.
* **Eager Learner:** You see feedback as fuel.
* **You enjoy both working as part of the People Team and collaborating with it:** You come to our Berlin-Mitte office at least twice a week to work alongside us.

**Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto**
------------------------------------

* **Best of Both Worlds:** We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.
* **Work from (Almost) Anywhere:** We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.
* **Recharge & Unwind:** We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested.
* **Multicultural & Inclusive Team:** We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.
* **Fuel Your Growth:** We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.
* **Exclusive Employee Discounts:** Get more for your money with access to the "Benefits at Work" platform, offering significant discounts on top global brands.
* **Your Benefits, Your Choice:** Through Probonio, you get a monthly budget to spend on what matters to you—whether that’s your public transport pass or other flexible perks that fit your lifestyle.

**What Matters to Us**
----------------------

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!  
  
We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

----------------

* **Artificial Intelligence (AI):** Du wirkst an praxisnahen AI-Anwendungsfällen mit, zum Beispiel an der Auswertung von Verträgen, der Analyse von Geschäftspartner- und Nutzungsdaten oder der Automatisierung von Recherche und Reporting. * **Analyse & Insights:** Du recherchierst und analysierst Daten zu Geschäftspartnern, Verträgen, Software, Cloud-Nutzung und Kosten. Dabei hilfst du, Transparenz zu schaffen, Auffälligkeiten zu erkennen und Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.

------------------

* **Fortgeschrittenes Studium** der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwissenschaften, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit guten Leistungen

* **Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office**, insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint, sowie Interesse an datengetriebenen Fragestellungen. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Artificial Intelligence oder AI-gestützten Tools sind willkommen
* **Strukturierte Arbeitsweise**, analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen eigenständig und gemeinsam im Team zu bearbeiten und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln
* **Deutsch und Englisch** sehr gut in Wort und Schrift sowie Bereitschaft zu projektbezogenen Reisen

* **Work-Life-Balance** in einem innovativen Unternehmensumfeld, das dir Gesundheitstage, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events und vieles mehr bietet

Wir suchen ab sofort Studierende für eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit für mindestens 6 Monate - sehr gerne auch länger.

**About Zalando**
-----------------

Zalando is Europe’s leading online platform for fashion and lifestyle. As a company that connects customers, brands, and partners across europe, our physical footprint is vast and ever-evolving.

  
  

From our state-of-the-art tech hubs and corporate headquarters in Berlin to our expansive logistics network, our environments directly impact our efficiency and culture.

We are looking for a working student that would support several intercompany transactions and processes.

Are you currently studying finance or business administration with a strong passion for accounting? Join our finance team as a working student and gain hands-on experience in general ledger accounting, with a specific focus on our global intercompany operations.

  
  

**WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)**

* Support Month-End Closing: Take an active role in the month-end closing process, specifically handling intercompany billing and reconciliation.
* Master Data Management: Assist in creating and maintaining IC master data to ensure seamless processes across entities.
* ERP & Systems Experience: Gain valuable, practical experience working directly in SAP S/4HANA, our central financial ERP system.
* Join Initial Projects: Get involved in exciting first project tasks. Analyse and understand our group-wide IC constellations and workflows.
* Team Collaboration: Work closely with the General Ledger team on day-to-day accounting activities.
  

  

**WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF**

* Education: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field with a clear focus on Accounting/Finance.
* Mindset: An open, curious, and proactive attitude with a genuine interest in corporate accounting and financial systems.
* Skills: Strong attention to detail, structured thinking, and good basic knowledge of financial accounting principles (prior exposure or interest in SAP S/4HANA is a plus!).
* Languages: Working proficiency in English (German is a plus)
  

  

**Our Offer**

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.

* 27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
* 40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
* Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
* Company pension scheme
* Employee shares programme
* Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
* Mental health support and coaching
* Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
* 2 paid volunteering days a year
* Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)
  

  

**INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN**

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

  
  

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

  
  

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

title: SAP iXp Intern (f/m/d) - Adoption & Consumption Operations
description:
**We help the world run better**
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
  
  
**About The Role**
You'll support the team in two areas: how we run our projects, and how we work with data. You'll use AI tools, agents and skills every day to prepare meetings, summarize outcomes, analyze data and automate recurring tasks, and you'll help us find new ways to apply them.
  
  
In project management, your focus will be on post-merger integration: you'll help integrate portfolios that SAP has acquired. This is a good fit if you like structure, enjoy working with people, are curious about what the numbers show, and want hands-on experience with AI in a real business setting.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Project management & post-merger integration:
  
  

* Support project management for the post-merger integration of acquired portfolios by tracking timelines, dependencies and open points across workstreams
* Organize and prepare team and stakeholder meetings, including agendas, materials, notes and follow-ups
* Keep the project action trackers up to date and help make sure open items get followed up
* Summarize outcomes, decisions and next steps, and share them with the right audiences
* Maintain project status materials and updates for leadership reviews

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Create ad-hoc reports and analyses that answer business questions from the team and stakeholders
* Help maintain and improve dashboards in SAP Analytics Cloud and other BI tools
* Gather and document requirements for new reports or enhancements
* Identify ways to automate recurring reporting tasks based on AI Agents & Skills

**What You’ll Bring**
We’re looking for someone who takes the initiative, perseveres, and stays curious. You like to work on meaningful innovative projects and are energized by lifelong learning.
  
  

* Currently enrolled in a Master's program in business, economics, information systems or a related field
* Strong organizational skills: you keep track of details and follow through
* Clear, structured communication in English, both written and spoken, German is a plus
* An analytical mindset and confidence working with data in Excel or similar tools
* Solid PowerPoint skills
* Previous internship or working student experience in operations, consulting, project management or analytics
* A proactive attitude and the confidence to ask questions and suggest improvements
* Working from Berlin office is required. If you are applying from outside the area, please mention your relocation plans or preferences in your CV (Relocation costs are not reimbursed by the manager/employer)

**Nice To Have**

* First experience with BI tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI or Tableau
* Interest & first experience in using AI tools to work more efficiently

**Where You Belong**
Be part of SAP Next Gen, a global community for students, universities, schools and educational partners, who are passionate about innovation and technology.
  
  

* Culture of Collaboration: Partner with experienced SAP colleagues and expert mentors who will support your growth. Grow professionally through personalized mentoring, coaching, and career development support.
* Project-driven Experience: Kickstart your career with hands-on learning experience, making an impact from day one by contributing to meaningful projects that help the world run better. You’ll have endless learning resources at your fingertips and gain future-ready skills from a variety of virtual, in-person, and hybrid learning sessions, cultivated just for you, and aligned with our learning approach.
* Gain Visibility: Build relationships with leaders and peers across teams and functions. Showcase your ideas, skills, and creativity in a global, fast-paced environment. Open doors for future career opportunities within SAP and beyond.

**The Team**
**The Adoption & Consumption Practices And Platform Team**

* Lives end-to-end responsibility for business practices such as solution adoption planning, demand generation, renewal risk management
* Defines supporting infrastructure for customer-facing colleagues for improving customer satisfaction and driving adoption and consumption of our solutions
* Manages business requirements from customer-facing roles on systems, processes and analytics in close collaboration with the internal IT organization
* Introduces innovative instruments built on the newest technologies such as Artificial Intelligence to customer success management teams

*Follow @LifeatSAP on Instagram and don't miss anything about our experiences worldwide!*
*#SAPNextGen*
**Bring out your best**
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
  
  
**We win with inclusion**
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
  
  
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
  
  
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
  
  
**AI Usage in the Recruitment Process**
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.
  
  
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Mandatory Internship – Technical Project Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
**About ecopals**
-----------------

ecopals is building the leading performance additive platform for asphalt and bitumen modification, engineered for regional, sovereign supply chains and backed by strong unit economics. Our current product line is built on high-performance polymers, with further additive categories in active development. In the last two years, we have scaled to active operations in more than 10 EU countries, and we are now pushing decisively into Eastern Europe, CEE and North Africa.

As we enter our next growth phase, we are opening a mandatory internship position for **Technical Project Engineer (m/f/d)**. The role works closely with our R&D, commercial and management teams and supports the implementation of technical projects across suppliers, laboratories, development partners and customers.

The position is particularly suited to someone who enjoys combining engineering, project coordination and analytical work, and who can help move technical projects from an initial concept toward testing, documentation and implementation.

**Tasks**
---------

In this internship, you will support the development and execution of technical projects around ecopals' products and applications. A key part of the role is helping coordinate the different internal and external parties involved and ensuring that technical activities, information and next steps continue moving forward.

**Areas of responsibility**

* **Technical project coordination.** Supporting the planning and execution of development and application projects, including timelines, technical requirements, responsibilities and next steps.
* **Supplier and partner coordination.** Working with material suppliers, laboratories, manufacturers and technical partners to request information, clarify requirements, follow up on open topics and help keep projects progressing.
* **Project communication and follow-up.** Preparing and following up on emails, technical requests, meeting notes, action points and documentation required from internal and external stakeholders.

title: Working Student (m/w/d) - Cyber Security Engineering
description:
As a leading global software product company in Compliance & Automation, IMTF Group develops innovative RegTech solutions focusing on Anti-Money Laundering, Know Your Customer, and Anti-Fraud. Our technology helps financial institutions fight financial crime and meet demanding regulatory requirements.

At IMTF, we value innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. We encourage our teams to explore new technologies, challenge existing approaches, and continuously improve how we develop and deliver secure software.

As a Working Student in Cyber Security Engineering, you will join our Research & Development organization and help improve the security tools we develop and use internally. You will work on vulnerability scanners, security automation, and supporting software that helps us identify, assess, and address security risks across our products.

This is a hands-on software engineering role where you can apply your academic knowledge to real-world security challenges.

### **Responsibilities**

* Develop and enhance our internal security tools, including vulnerability scanners and automated security checks
* Improve vulnerability detection, analysis, and reporting to deliver accurate and actionable security findings
* Help automate security assessments of applications, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure
* Contribute to tools and processes for software supply chain security, including SBOM and vulnerability management
* Research emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security technologies and evaluate their relevance to our software
* Integrate security tools and automated checks into our development and CI/CD workflows
* Collaborate with software engineers to improve the effectiveness and reliability of our security tooling
* Explore opportunities to leverage AI and automation to make security analysis more efficient

  
**Requirements**  

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Cyber Security, IT Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Basic programming skills, preferably in Python, and an interest in developing real-world software
* Foundational understanding of IT security, networking, operating systems, and common software vulnerabilities
* Interest in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and DevSecOps practices
* Familiarity with Linux, Git, or container technologies is an advantage
* Curiosity about security tools, automation, and emerging technologies
* Analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills, and a hands-on approach
* Interest in using modern AI-assisted development tools
* Ability to work independently while actively collaborating with a development team
* Good communication skills in English; German language skills are an advantage

Previous professional experience in Cyber Security is not required. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn.

 **Benefits**  

* **Make the World Safer:** Help us strengthen the security of software used to combat financial crime
* **Be Part of an Established RegTech:** Gain practical experience at an international Swiss software company
* **Hands-on Engineering:** Work on real security software and contribute improvements that make a measurable difference
* **Ownership and Development:** Take responsibility for your work, learn from experienced engineers, and develop your technical skills
* **Paid Further Education:** Benefit from opportunities to expand your knowledge and professional capabilities
* **International Exposure:** Collaborate with colleagues across different countries and engineering disciplines

The anticipated salary for this Working Student - Cyber Engineering position in Germany is EUR 18,000 gross per year, based on a 20-hour working week (50% employment level).

At IMTF, we are committed to treating all candidates with respect and equality, regardless of gender, religion, nationality, or any other characteristic. We embrace diversity and inclusion as integral parts of our organizational culture and welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

description:

* Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: profitiere von regelmäßigem Feedback und bringe deine eigene Perspektive in unsere Unternehmenskultur ein. Zusätzlich erhältst du einen einjährigen kostenfreien Zugang zu LinkedIn Learning, den du auch nach deiner Zeit bei uns nutzen kannst.

Und jetzt kommst du: mitten hinein in die offene, wertschätzende Start-up-Atmosphäre eines etablierten Unternehmens mit 40-jähriger Erfolgsgeschichte.

**Hier Bewegst Du Was**

* Du wirkst im Transformation Office bei Projektmanagement- und Governance-Aktivitäten für unser unternehmensweites Transformationsprogramm mit und arbeitest dabei mit verschiedenen Projektteams und Funktionen zusammen.
* Du unterstützt das Projekt- und OKR-Reporting (Objectives and Key Results), konsolidierst Status-Updates und bereitest Präsentationen und Unterlagen für Projekt- und Leadership-Meetings vor.

* Du setzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT für wiederkehrende Aufgaben ein, zum Beispiel für Meeting-Dokumentationen, Reporting, Informationskonsolidierung und die Erstellung von Unterlagen.
* Du wirkst an Prozessverbesserungs- und Automatisierungsinitiativen mit und hilfst dabei, effizientere Arbeitsweisen mithilfe von KI sowie Tools wie Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint und Excel zu identifizieren, zu testen und umzusetzen.

**Hiermit Begeisterst Du**

* Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang eingeschrieben – unabhängig von deiner Fachrichtung.
* Du hast bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder andere relevante Tätigkeiten gesammelt.
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
* Du bringst sehr gute organisatorische und administrative Fähigkeiten mit und hast Freude daran, Aufgaben zu koordinieren, Fristen im Blick zu behalten und strukturiert zu arbeiten.
* Du gehst sicher mit MS-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel, um und hast großes Interesse an KI und Automatisierung – idealerweise hast du bereits praktische Erfahrung mit Tools wie ChatGPT gesammelt.
* Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und sorgfältig und fühlst dich in der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams und Stakeholdern in einem internationalen Umfeld wohl.

Du willst dich gleich bei uns bewerben? Dann schick deine Unterlagen über den „Apply now“-Button zu uns. Bitte beachte, dass wir aus Datenschutzgründen keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail annehmen können. Alle wichtigen Informationen rund um deine Bewerbung findest du in unseren FAQs .
  
  
Du willst mehr über uns und unsere Unternehmenskultur erfahren? Hier geht's zu unserem Recruiting Video. .
  
  
**Über Simon-Kucher**
Simon-Kucher ist eine globale Unternehmensberatung mit mehr als 2.200 Mitarbeitenden in über 30 Ländern. Unser Fokus liegt darauf, nachhaltiges und profitables Wachstum zu erschließen und für unsere Kunden messbare Umsatz- und Ergebnissteigerungen zu realisieren. Als verlässlicher Partner für Commercial Excellence verbinden wir tiefgehende Beratungsexpertise mit Spezialisierung auf Wachstumsstrategien und technologischer Expertise, um nachhaltige Wertsteigerung zu ermöglichen. Wir optimieren sämtliche Hebel der kommerziellen Strategie – von Produkt, Pricing und Innovation bis hin zu Marketing, Vertrieb und digitalen Geschäftsmodellen – auf Basis fundierter Erkenntnisse zu Kundennutzen und Zahlungsbereitschaft. Mit über 40 Jahren Erfahrung in der Monetarisierung gelten wir als weltweit führende Beratung für Commercial Growth und Pricing. simon-kucher.com
  
  
Wir setzen uns für eine Unternehmenskultur ein, die Diversität, Gleichstellung und Inklusion fördert – und damit ein Umfeld der Anerkennung, das individuelle Entfaltung stärkt und den Beitrag eines jeden Einzelnen würdigt. So können wir weitreichende und positive Veränderungen bewirken. Wertschätzung und Anerkennung befähigen uns dazu, schneller zu wachsen, innovativer zu arbeiten und nachhaltigere Ergebnisse für alle zu erzielen – für unsere Teams, unsere Kunden und unser Unternehmen.

recruitment.germany(at)simon-kucher.com
