title: Working Student Retail Growth
description:
#### **What you will do**

* **Core responsibilities (your main focus):**
  + Managing and processing B2B orders, ensuring smooth and timely fulfillment with high attention to detail & practical use of AI when relevant.
  + Automatization of order management and other operational processes, helping to identify and resolve issues and improve efficiency with practical use of AI.
  + Owner of new product launches across all accounts.
* **Supporting responsibilities (you will contribute & learn):**
  + Supporting the management of B2B accounts and day-to-day communication with partners.
  + Assisting in monitoring key retail KPIs (e.g. sell-out, stock levels, availability) and preparing reports.
  + Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Product, Operations) to support execution of projects.
* **Optional stretch (based on your development):**
  + Taking ownership of smaller projects and/or owning from start-to-end your own Account & drive growth.

#### **What we're looking for**

* You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Business Administration, International Management, or a related field.
* You are available to work 20 hours per week from Berlin.
* You have gained first practical experience (e.g. internship or working student role), ideally in a fast-paced or entrepreneurial environment.
* You have a strong interest in retail, e-commerce, and commercial topics, and are excited to learn how businesses grow.
* You are analytical and detail-oriented, with a structured and reliable way of working.
* You enjoy working with data & AI and are eager to translate insights into actions.
* You bring a hands-on mentality and enjoy supporting a team in a fast-paced environment.
* You are proactive, eager to learn, and take ownership of your tasks.
* You are fluent in German and English.

#### **Why you should join us**

* **A charity day, just for you** — one paid day per year to give back however feels right to you. Solo or with your team. Your call.
* **€70 monthly gitti product voucher** — yes, really. Stock up on your favourites or try everything new. You deserve it.
* **€50/month wellness budget** — choose between Urban Sports Club, ClassPass, or Wolt. No top-up needed, just pick what fuels you.
* **Deutschlandticket, on us** — we cover your public transport costs. Better for you, better for the planet. Conscious commuting starts here.
* **Company pension with a 20% employer top-up** — we invest in your future because you invest in ours. Save smarter, not harder.
* **Hybrid & flexible working** — we come together **at least 3 days per week in our Berlin office** to collaborate and connect. Beyond that, work from home or remotely as your role allows.

#### **About us**

**WE ARE CONSCIOUS BEAUTY PIONEERS.**  
**WE STAND FOR PRODUCTS THAT ARE BETTER FOR US AND THE PLANET.**  
  
The Conscious Beauty Brand from Berlin was founded by Jennifer Baum-Minkus with a clear mission: to usher in a new era in the beauty industry with product innovations that are better for the planet and for us humans. The brand stands for a conscious and holistic approach to beauty that focuses on positive change. Since its inception, gitti has been pushing the boundaries of the industry through innovation for the future: from selecting safe ingredients to developing powerful formulas and sustainably designed packaging solutions. gitti is also strongly committed to rethinking beauty standards and advocates for diversity and inclusion. The close connection between nature and science is the basis for all gitti products. In its development process, gitti emphasizes the highest possible use of ingredients of natural origin and supplements these with carefully selected, highly effective functional ingredients. gitti became known for its groundbreaking product innovations. From water-based nail polish and a 100% natural nail polish remover to makeup and skincare, the brand stands for combining natural ingredients with powerful formulas. All products are always vegan and PETA-certified. Over the years, gitti has become a popular multi-category brand.  
  
Find out more about who we are and what we stand for **here**.  
Are you ready to revolutionize the beauty industry with us?  
We cannot wait to meet you!

------------------

As a working student in B2C SEO and AI Search, you will support us in the following areas:

* Content SEO, CMS and editing: support content strategies, maintain WordPress content, and optimize copy for patients and search

* How to collaborate across local and international marketing teams

* Are familiar with a CMS such as WordPress and with AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT

### **Now, it would be fantastic if you:**

* Have first experience in SEO or content marketing and with tools such as Google Search Console or Keyword Planner

Bei uns arbeitest Du in engagierten Teams, mit ausgeprägtem Pioniergeist. Wir fördern fachliches Wachstum ebenso wie persönliche Entwicklung und schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Offenheit, Qualität und gegenseitige Wertschätzung selbstverständlich sind.

* Wirke bei KI- und Innovationsprojekten mit, hole Informationen ein und pflege unsere Sharepoint-Seite zum Thema Innovation

title: GTM - Founder's Associate Intern (m/w/d) - Vertical AI Startup
description:
**Praktikum als Founder's Associate (m/w/d) mit Option auf Übernahme**

Wir bauen das KI-native ERP-System für Sanitär-, Heizungs- und Klimabetriebe (SHK). Unsere Pre-Seed-Runde ist abgeschlossen. Seit dem Go-Live haben wir 10 Kunden für uns gewonnen. Für die nächste Wachstumsphase suchen wir eine Person für die Rolle des Founder's Associate.

Du arbeitest eng mit dem Gründerteam und übernimmst von Beginn an echte Verantwortung in einer Rolle, die du selbst mitgestaltest.

**Aufgaben**

* Du baust KI-Agenten für repetitive Aufgaben. Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Abläufe bei unseren Kunden und automatisierst sie, damit Zeit für das Wesentliche frei wird.
* Du entwickelst unser Launch- und Go-Live-Playbook und etablierst es als Standard für jeden neuen Kunden. Dazu gehören die Einrichtung des Google-Business-Accounts, das IT-Setup und das Onboarding auf unser KI-Betriebssystem. Dein Ziel ist ein Prozess, der jeden Kunden zuverlässig, schnell und in gleichbleibender Qualität live bringt.
* Du verantwortest die P&L deiner Kunden und entwickelst sie weiter. Du verstehst das Geschäftsmodell deiner Kunden im Detail, identifizierst die relevanten Wachstumshebel und setzt sie konsequent um.
* Du integrierst dich tief in die jeweilige Branche. Wir bauen kein generisches SaaS, sondern verzahnen uns eng mit den Abläufen unserer Kunden. Dieselbe Tiefe erwarten wir in deinem Verständnis der Kunden.

**Qualifikation**

* Du hast bereits Praktikumserfahrung in Beratung, Banking oder einem Startup gesammelt. Du denkst strukturiert und lieferst trotzdem schnell.
* Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, da unsere Kunden ausschließlich auf Deutsch arbeiten.
* Du fühlst dich im direkten Kontakt mit unseren Kunden wohl. Du gehst offen auf Unternehmer zu, triffst ihren Ton und baust schnell ein echtes Vertrauensverhältnis auf.
* Du verbindest operative Exzellenz mit echtem Customer-Success-Denken. Du baust belastbare Prozesse und lässt gleichzeitig Kunden wachsen. Beide Seiten sind für diese Rolle gleich wichtig.
* Du suchst Ownership und großen Gestaltungsspielraum statt eng definierter Vorgaben.

**Benefits**

* Die Möglichkeit, nach dem Praktikum in Vollzeit übernommen zu werden.
* Eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung.
* Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche gemeinsam im Office in Berlin Mitte.
* Eine direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau eines Unternehmens und Teams aus der ersten Reihe mitzugestalten.

Werde Founder's Associate Intern bei Meisterpfad und gestalte die Zukunft von KI im Handwerk mit uns!

title: People & Culture - Working Student (m/f/d)
description:
Fotografiska Berlin – the contemporary museum of photography, art, and culture – opened in September 2023 with a mission to inspire new perspectives and spark conversations through photography and contemporary art. More than a museum, it’s a vibrant cultural space in the heart of the city, where art, creativity, hospitality, and community come together.

As part of the global Fotografiska family — with locations in Stockholm, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Tallinn, and soon Oslo — we provide a vibrant platform for creative expression and critical dialogue, making culture accessible and cultivating community in everything we do.

Join our dynamic team, and shape with us a forward-thinking museum experience that captures and expands Berlin’s unique energy.

At Fotografiska Berlin, we bring together diverse perspectives, foster an inclusive environment, and believe that our people are at the heart of everything we do.

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Working Student People & Culture (m/f/d)** to join our team and support us across a broad range of HR activities.

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience across the entire employee lifecycle, contribute to smooth People & Culture operations, and help us create a positive employee experience. Be part of our journey as we redefine what a museum can be!

##### **Your Responsibilities**

##### **People & Culture Operations & Administration**

* Support the day-to-day administration and coordination of all People & Culture processes throughout the employee lifecycle.
* Assist with the preparation and administration of employment contracts, contract amendments, reference letters, certificates, and other HR-related documents.
* Maintain and update employee records, personnel files, and HR databases, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding processes, including document preparation, coordination, and administrative follow-up.
* Handle general administrative tasks and respond to employee requests related to People & Culture matters.

##### **Training & Development**

* Support the planning, organization, and coordination of employee training and development initiatives.
* Assist with training administration, scheduling, documentation, and communication.
* Contribute to initiatives that promote employee engagement, learning, and professional development.

##### **People & Culture Projects & Initiatives**

* Provide holistic support to the People & Culture team across operational, administrative, and organizational topics.
* Support ongoing People & Culture projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the overall employee experience.
* Collaborate with different departments and act as a reliable point of support for day-to-day HR matters.

##### **Your Profile**

* Currently enrolled in a degree program in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Social Sciences, or a related field.
* Ideally, some initial experience in HR, administration, or a similar role.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a structured, proactive approach to work.

title: Working Student Client Experience (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a **mission to make investing as easy as spending money**. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by **€280M in total funding** from world-class investors, including **BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive**. Our latest **€105M funding round in March 2026** - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

**About the role:**
===================

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the **Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD)** replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as a **Working Student** in **Client Experience** and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

**What you’ll do:**
===================

* **Support our clients:** Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.
* **Support day-to-day AVD operations:** Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.
* **Help build the playbooks:** As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.
* **Support error handling and reconciliation:** Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.
* **Spot what should be better:** You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

**What you bring:**
===================

* Fluent German communication skills (B2/C1), along with comfortable working proficiency in English This one is a hard requirement rather than a nice-to-have: the regulation, the correspondence with the ZfA, and most of the documentation you'll work with day to day are all in German.
* You're structured and genuinely precise. In this role, small details carry real consequences for someone's pension, and you're the kind of person who notices when a number doesn't add up.
* You're curious about rules rather than put off by them. You're willing to read the actual regulation to understand why a process works the way it does.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity. The product is brand new, so some answers don't exist yet; you'll ask good questions instead of waiting for perfect instructions.
* You're confident with spreadsheets and AI tooling. Any prior exposure to financial services, operations or a regulated environment is a bonus, but not required.
* You're available for a minimum of 6 months and based in Berlin.

**How we Upvest in you:**
=========================

* **Impact-driven work:** We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.
* **Team celebrations:** Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.
* **Inclusion**: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

**Our Values:**
===============

* **Make it easy for others.** We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.
* **Own the outcome.** We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.
* **Rise to the challenge.** We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.
* **Tell the story.** We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
DEMECAN, unser Name steht für Deutsches Medizinal-Cannabis. Unser Ziel ist es, die Lebensqualität von Patient:innen zu verbessern, indem ihnen der Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis in „Made in Germany“-Qualität ermöglicht wird. Im Mai 2019 erhielt DEMECAN als einziges unabhängiges deutsches Unternehmen den Zuschlag zur Produktion von medizinischem Cannabis in Deutschland. In der Nähe von Dresden haben wir das Zentrum für medizinisches Cannabis mit einem modernen Indoor-Gewächshaus aufgebaut. Dort wachsen und blühen derzeit unsere exklusiven Cannabispflanzen.

Wir verstehen uns als Pionier und Experte im Bereich Cannabis. Leistung, Initiative und Verantwortung zeichnet unsere Mitarbeiter:innen und unser Team aus. Durch flache Hierarchien und eine offene Feedback-Kultur hat jede:r im Team die Möglichkeit, unsere Entwicklung mitzugestalten und medizinisches Cannabis in Deutschland zu einer Erfolgsstory zu machen. Geh' mit uns den nächsten Schritt in Deiner Karriere und bewirb Dich bei uns.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Berlin suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudent (m/w/d) Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth Management.

**Was wir bieten:**

* flexible Arbeitszeiten (mobiles Arbeiten möglich)

* Du bist sehr sicher im Umgang mit Excel (Pivot, XVERWEIS, idealerweise Power Query) und PowerPoint

* Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und gut Englisch

**Deine Aufgaben:**

title: Working Student Sales Operations (all genders)
description:
**Wir sind Neuraum**

  

Jetzt beginnt für uns die nächste Wachstumsphase. Unser Ziel ist es, unsere kommerzielle Organisation auf das nächste Level zu heben, unsere wichtigsten Kunden strategisch weiterzuentwickeln und neue Wachstumspotenziale zu erschließen.

  

**Du bei Neuraum**

  

Als Working Student Sales Operations nimmst du Einträge in unserem CRM-System Salesforce und weiteren internen Systemen vor und sorgst so dafür, dass unsere Kunden ihre Leistungen erhalten und zufrieden sind. Du bekommst von Anfang an echte Verantwortung und wirst dabei unterstützt von netten Kolleg:innen und genauen Anleitungen. Du sammelst so wertvolle Erfahrungen in der Tech-Branche sowie mit Salesforce, dem weltweit führendem CRM-System.

  

Du arbeitest 15 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche (idealerweise 20) an festen Tagen. Du wirst fester Bestandteil unseres Teams und dein Start folgt einem klaren Onboarding Plan. Hast Du die ersten Aufgaben im Griff, wächst deine Rolle mit dir, bis du auch in dringenden Fällen für Kolleg:innen einspringen kannst. Wir erwarten viel und belohnen das auch.

  

**Deine Tätigkeiten**

  

  
* Verträge in Salesforce anpassen: Du setzt Vertragsänderungen im CRM-System für unsere Partner um und stellst sicher, dass jede Anpassung korrekt und zeitnah erfolgt (“Unteraccountanpassungen”).
  
* Partner onboarden: Du richtest neue Partner und Verträge in unseren Systemen ein, inkl. der Vertragsanlage im CRM-System sowie der Erstellung des Partner-Portraits auf unseren Hausbauplattformen.
  
* B2C-Tickets lösen: Du bearbeitest Interessenten-Fragen und Anliegen und sorgst für schnelle, freundliche Lösungen.
  
* B2B-Account-Support: Du unterstützt unsere B2B-Kund:innen, zum Beispiel bei Login-Problemen oder Fragen zu unseren Systemen.
  
* Vertretung im Team: Du springst bei Abwesenheit (z. B. Urlaub oder Krankheit) ein und sicherst so, dass nichts liegen bleibt.
  
* Projekte & Sales-Team-Admin: Du unterstützt bei Projekten und Admin-Aufgaben, zum Beispiel bei Mailings oder Aktionen wie Weihnachtskarten.
  

  

**Was du mitbringst**

  

  
* Student:in mit Plan: Du bist immatrikuliert (BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ein administrativer Studiengang - wir sind aber auch offen für andere Studiengänge), hast noch mindestens ein Jahr Studium vor dir und willst mindestens ein Jahr mit uns durchstarten.

* Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du übernimmst Aufgaben, die unser Team spürbar entlasten, und siehst direkt, welchen Unterschied deine Arbeit macht.
  
* Strukturierter Einstieg: Wir starten mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben und arbeiten dich eng ein. Dein Aufgabengebiet erweiterst du Schritt für Schritt, bis du auch komplexere Prozesse wie das Onboarding neuer Partner eigenständig betreust.
  
* Faire Vergütung: Du erhältst eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung für Werkstudierende.
  
* Einblick in einen Marktführer: Du lernst die Prozesse, Systeme und Kundenbeziehungen eines marktführenden Hausbau-Portals von innen kennen.
  
* Salesforce Erfahrung: Du baust Dir Know-How mit dem weltweit führendem CRM-System Salesforce auf, was Dir viele Karriere-Chancen eröffnet.
  
* Ein starkes Team: Dich erwartet ein engagiertes, ambitioniertes Team mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer pragmatischen „Let's get things done“-Mentalität. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir uns kontinuierlich weiter.
  
* Schnelligkeit statt Bürokratie: Dank moderner Systeme, sauberer Daten und einer schlanken Organisation kannst du Ideen schnell umsetzen, Prozesse verbessern und echten Impact erzielen – ohne dich in Konzernstrukturen zu verlieren.
  
* Sichtbarer Business Impact: Deine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, unsere Kunden erfolgreicher zu machen, langfristige Partnerschaften auszubauen und unsere Marktführerschaft weiter zu stärken.
  
* Stabilität trifft Startup-Mentalität: Profitiere von der Dynamik und Kultur unseres Teams und gleichzeitig von der Sicherheit, den Ressourcen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten der internationalen AVIV Group.
  
* Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Arbeite eng mit erfahrenen Führungskräften zusammen, übernimm anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen und entwickle dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  
* Flexibilität & Benefits: Ein modernes Büro direkt am Landwehrkanal in Berlin-Kreuzberg, regelmäßige Teamevents und feste Arbeitstage, die wir mit deinem Studienplan abstimmen.
  

  

**Alle sind Willkommen**

  

Bei Neuraum sind unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Lebenswege ausdrücklich willkommen. Wenn du glaubst, dass diese Rolle zu deiner Erfahrung und deinen Ambitionen passt, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

  

**Wie bewerben?**

  

Klingt das alles gut und würdest du gerne mehr erfahren? Dann melde dich bei uns! Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil. Wenn du Fragen hast, melde dich gerne bei unserer People Managerin Kaja unter jobs@neuraum.com oder erfahre mehr über uns auf.

title: Office Management Working Student (D/F/M)
description:
#### **WORK WITH US!**

**About SEEK Development**

SEEK is a social impact consulting group that supports its clients to be a force for global human development, working across global health, climate adaptation, education and gender. Our portfolio of services includes strategy and policy development, organisational effectiveness, development finance, resource mobilisation and strategic advocacy.

Global health is our core portfolio and the area we are most widely known for across the ecosystem, serving major players spanning foundations, multilateral organisations, product-development partnerships, governments, civil society and the private sector.

We combine top management consulting approaches with cutting-edge global health and development ecosystem knowledge. We offer a fast-paced, stimulating and international work environment, allowing each team member to professionally develop and grow in their mission to make positive and lasting contributions to a more equitable and sustainable world.

#### **ABOUT YOUR ROLE**

SEEK’s Finance and Operations team is the backbone of our organization that is dedicated to working for a world where everyone, everywhere can thrive and realize their potential.  
In this important role as **Office Management Working Student (D/F/M**) you will take ownership of our office operations. You will be the go-to person for employee inquiries and be the one who masters the office / meeting room IT infrastructure – in short: You are running the office!

**Duties and responsibilities**

  

* Be the go-to person for the office community. Handle administrative duties, answer questions and make the office feel like home for our international team. This role requires that you are physically present in the office during your work time.
* Procure non-IT office supplies, manage inventory and place orders.
* Plan and maintain workspaces (office, kitchen, workstations) and manage provider contracts (e.g. rent, energy, insurance).
* Support health and safety organisation and compliance with authorities (TÜV, VBG, quarterly H&S meeting), and coordinate data protection with the data protection officer.
* Manage incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries, greet visitors and handle digital and physical document filing.
* Act as contact for our external IT helpdesk and manage IT inventory, orders and maintenance requests.
* Organise recurring team events, including calendar, bookings and gifts.
* Run ad-hoc projects and help improve our administrative processes and digital tools.

#### **ABOUT YOU**

You are the heart of the office, driven by a passion for ensuring that the needs of our team are met with care and efficiency. With a can-do attitude and hands-on approach, you solve problems proactively and keep everything running smoothly. Your organizational and digital skills, attention to detail, and fluent German and English language skills make you a key player in our team’s success. Strong communication skills and a positive mindset define your interactions at all levels. You enjoy the buzz of a young, excited team.

**What makes you a great fit for this exciting role:**

* You have experience working in a fast-paced environment in a similar role.
* You enjoy the advantage of digitalization and executing clear processes
* You have an excellent command of all MS tools (Teams, SharePoint, etc)
* You enjoy learning and keen to further improve process
* You communicate fluently in German and English.
* You are aware that teamwork makes the dream work. Spiced by effective self-organisation!
* Active student status required

#### **WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER**

* International environment
* Passionate, dynamic, and values-driven team of colleagues
* Strong focus on individual professional development with hands-on mentorship and training to see you thrive
* Female leadership and diverse team
* BVG company ticket, Jobrad program, Urban Sports Club

#### **DIVERSITY STATEMENT**

As an equal opportunity employer, we at SEEK are committed to a diverse, inclusive and healthy work environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnicity, color, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.

#### **APPLICATION DEADLINE + START DATE**

asap

#### **YOUR CANDIDATE JOURNEY**

Please submit your application (CV, cover letter, job references).

We will screen applications on a rolling basis - selected candidates will be invited for our interview process including multiple stages:

* We will check your application documents and get back to you in a timely manner
* Introductory call with HR via video call - 30 minutes
* Interview with our COO & FNO colleauge- 60 minutes
* Meet the team: visit our office and talk to some members of our Team - 30 minutes
* Offer

#### **About us**

We are **SEEK**ers of a world where everyone, everywhere can thrive and realize their potential. As a social impact consulting group, we support our clients to be a force for global human development with a focus on global health, education, climate adaptation, education, and gender. **SEEK**’s portfolio of services includes strategy and policy development; development finance, resource mobilization and strategic advocacy; and organizational effectiveness.  
In our work, we combine top management consulting approaches with cutting-edge knowledge of the global health and development ecosystem. As part of our work, we run the Donor Tracker platform, a free, online resource that unlocks advocacy potential by providing access to high-quality strategic information on development financing and policy.

title: Product Security Lead
description:
If you are a **Product Security Lead** professional Iooking for an opportunity to grow your career, Emerson has an exciting opportunity for you in **Berlin, Germany** . In this role, you will lead product security activities across the product lifecycle, helping ensure that secure-by-design principles are embedded into development processes, products, and solutions. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, product management, quality, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to drive security excellence, manage cybersecurity risks, and support compliance with industry-recognized standards. This position offers the opportunity to influence product strategy, strengthen security capabilities, and contribute to solutions that make a meaningful impact for customers worldwide.

**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Develop, maintain, and own comprehensive product security plans, including defining security scope, objectives, deliverables and activities.
* Drive the implementation, execution, and continuous improvement of secure development lifecycle (SDL) practices in alignment with IEC 62443-4-1 requirements.
* Define and verify product security release criteria for new product development programs and ensure all required security activities, reviews, and evidence are completed before product releases.
* Establish, review, and maintain product security requirements while evaluating secure architecture and design concepts to ensure cybersecurity risks are appropriately mitigated.
* Lead product threat modeling activities, cybersecurity risk assessments, and security architecture reviews for assigned products and solutions.
* Maintain product security risk registers, ensuring identified threats, vulnerabilities, mitigation actions, risk owners, and risk acceptance decisions remain current, traceable, and well documented.
* Coordinate product-level vulnerability management, disclosure handling, and cybersecurity incident response activities.
* Represent assigned products in Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) investigations and remediation efforts.
* Ensure the creation, maintenance, and review of Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) and oversee Software Composition Analysis (SCA) activities.
* Monitor and assess cybersecurity risks associated with third-party, commercial, and open-source software components.
* Partner with development teams to identify, prioritize, and remediate security findings from security testing activities.
* Ensure security-related documentation, testing results, compliance evidence, and decision records are maintained throughout the product lifecycle.
* Establish and monitor product security metrics and key performance indicators and communicate status, risks, trends, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
* Escalate significant product security risks and compliance concerns to the Product Security Officer (PSO) as appropriate.
* Provide expert guidance to product teams regarding secure coding practices, vulnerability remediation, security architecture, and cybersecurity standards.
* Develop and deliver product security awareness and training sessions and mentor engineers and stakeholders on secure development methodologies.
* Collaborate with global teams to support product certifications, customer security assessments, audits, and regulatory compliance activities.
* Promote a culture of cybersecurity awareness, continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability across product development organizations.

**Who You Are:**

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Strong knowledge of secure development lifecycle practices and security-by-design principles.
* Experience applying and interpreting standards such as IEC 62443-4-1, IEC 62443-4-2, OWASP, or comparable industry frameworks.

* Familiarity with Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation, management, and compliance practices.
* Ability to interpret security findings, prioritize remediation activities, and effectively communicate risk-based recommendations.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, presentation, and communication skills.
* Experience working in cross-functional product development environments involving software, firmware, and/or industrial automation technologies.
* Ability to develop documentation, compliance evidence, and security-related reports with a high level of quality and traceability.
* Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging cybersecurity threats, technologies, and industry best practices.

* Experience within industrial automation, operational technology (OT), industrial control systems (ICS), embedded systems, or critical infrastructure environments.

**WHY EMERSON**

**Our Commitment to Our People**

title: Praktikum Product Management
description:
**Dein Impact**
Du arbeitest direkt an der Weiterentwicklung des Finanzfluss Copiloten, unserer Mobile App und der Finanzfluss Webseite mit. Gemeinsam mit dem Product Team entwickelst du neue Features, analysierst Nutzerbedürfnisse und setzt Produktideen um, die hunderttausende Nutzer erreichen. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für eigene Themen und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie Produkte bei Finanzfluss entstehen.
  
  
**Deine Aufgaben**

* Du analysierst Nutzerfeedback, Produktdaten sowie Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leitest daraus konkrete Produktideen und Handlungsempfehlungen ab
* Du entwickelst Konzepte und Business Cases für neue Features, Tools und Produktinitiativen
* Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Engineering, Design und Content zusammen, um neue Funktionen erfolgreich umzusetzen
* Du moderierst unsere Betatest-Gruppen und sorgst dafür, dass das Community-Feedback in die Weiterentwicklung einfließt

**Deine Skills**

* Du bist zuverlässig, arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und mit Liebe zum Detail
* Du kannst komplexe Themen schnell durchdringen und verständlich kommunizieren
* Du interessierst dich für Finanzen und Finanzprodukte und hast Lust, diese Themen anderen verständlich zu vermitteln
* Du bringst hohe Eigeninitiative mit und möchtest Dinge nicht nur mitdenken, sondern auch umsetzen
* Du nutzt KI-Tools (z. B. Claude, Lovable oder Figma Make) oder hast großes Interesse daran, diese für schnelles Prototyping, Produktkonzepte und datengetriebene Entscheidungen einzusetzen
* Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen gesammelt , z. B. im Product Management, Business Development, Startups, Consulting oder Venture Capital
* Sehr sichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2 oder Muttersprache)

**Wir bieten dir**

* Ein bezahltes Praktikum mit 2.531€ brutto pro Monat
* Ein schnelles Lernumfeld mit hoher Ownership und echtem Impact
* Die Möglichkeit, Finanzfluss und die Fintech-Branche aus nächster Nähe kennenzulernen
* Team-Events und vieles mehr!

**Über uns**
Bei uns zählst du. Bei Finanzfluss feiern wir Vielfalt und sind überzeugt, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven, Erfahrungen und Hintergründe uns als Team stärker machen. Deshalb heißen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, körperlichen Fähigkeiten oder Familienstand herzlich willkommen. Wenn du dich von dieser Stelle angesprochen fühlst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Werkstudierende mit Schwerpunkt Event- & Projektmanagement bei der Gesellschaft für Informatik (GI) in Berlin (m/w/d)
description:
#### **Zur Stelle**

Für unser Hauptstadtbüro suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Studierende für eine Stelle als Werkstudent\*in im Bereich „Event- & Projektmanagement“. Als Werkstudent\*in unterstützt du unser Eventmanagement bei der Konzeption, Planung & Umsetzung von verschiedenen Veranstaltungsformaten an der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Politik und Wirtschaft. Die Veranstaltungen adressieren unterschiedliche Zielgruppen, wie Schüler\*innen, Studierende, Wissenschaftler\*innen, sowie Vertreter\*innen der IT-Wirtschaft und Politik. Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche aber auch anspruchsvolle Aufgaben in den Bereichen Event- & Projektmanagement, Kommunikation, Netzwerkaufbau und -pflege, (Online-) Veranstaltungsmanagement und Research.  
  
Die Arbeitszeit beträgt 16-20h/Woche. Die Tätigkeit wird mit 16,50 €/Std. für BA-Studierende und 17,50€/Std. bei bereits abgeschlossener Hochschulausbildung (Bachelor) oder äquivalenter Berufserfahrung vergütet. **Die Bewerbungsfrist endet am 30. November 2026.** Die Stelle soll zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt besetzt werden.

#### **Deine Aufgaben**

* Unterstützung bei Konzeption, Organisation & Durchführung unterschiedlicher Events mit Schwerpunkt Digitalisierung
* Eigenverantwortliches Projektmanagement von kleineren Arbeitspaketen
* Sponsorenakquise & -betreuung sowie Vermarktung/PR der Veranstaltung
* Teilnehmer\*innen-Management & -Kommunikation
* Verfassen von Texten, Meldungen und Veranstaltungshinweisen
* Unterstützung von PR- und Kommunikationsmaßnahmen (on- und offline) – insbesondere Social Media
* Inhaltliche Pflege der Projektwebseiten

#### **Dein Profil**

* Du brennst für gute Events, auch abseits von klassischen Formaten.
* Du hast idealerweise erste Erfahrungen oder Praktika im Eventmanagement gemacht.
* Du arbeitest selbstständig, serviceorientiert und eigeninitiativ, entwickelst gern Ideen und Lösungen, bist gut organisiert und flexibel.
* Du arbeitest gerne in Teams, bist sehr zuverlässig und verfügst über kommunikatives Geschick.
* Du hast Interesse an Digitalisierungsthemen und Freude an organisatorischen als auch an inhaltlichen Tätigkeiten an der Schnittstelle von Digitalisierung, Nachhaltigkeit, Politik und Wissenschaft.

Wir möchten dich ausdrücklich auch dann zu einer Bewerbung ermutigen, wenn du nicht alle genannten Anforderungen erfüllst!

#### **Was wir Dir bieten**

Wir glauben, dass eine erfüllende, fair bezahlte und zukunftsfähige Beschäftigung die Grundlage für unsere erfolgreiche Arbeit ist. Die grundlegenden Prinzipien finden Sie in unserem Code of Conduct festgeschrieben. Darüber hinaus erhalten Sie als Kolleg\*in folgende Leistungen:

  

* 30 Urlaubstage (bei Vollzeit)
* Sehr flexibles Arbeiten und eine umfangreiche Home-Office-Möglichkeiten, sowie Arbeitsplätze im Herzen Berlins
* Kostenlose Getränke am Arbeitsplatz
* 1 Menstruationstag pro Monat für jede menstruierende Person
* Einen Betriebsrat, der sich für dich einsetzt

#### **Deine Bewerbung**

Wir freuen uns über deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung. Bitte nutze dafür ausschließlich unser Bewerbungsformular und lade dort folgende Dokumente hoch:

  

* Motivationsschreiben (max. 1 Seite)
* Lebenslauf (ohne Foto, ohne Angabe des Geburtsdatums und des Familienstands)
* ggf. Arbeitsproben / Referenzen (es reichen einfache Links)
* Gehaltsvorstellung und favorisierter Stundenumfang

Die Einreichung ist bis zum **30. November 2026 möglich** – erste Gespräche werden ggf. schon vorher geführt.  
  
Für inhaltliche Fragen zur ausgeschriebenen Stelle wende dich bitte an Alexander Scheibe (alexander.scheibe@gi.de).  
  
Alle Bewerbungen werden unabhängig von kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, von Geschlecht, Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung oder sexueller Orientierung nur auf die fachliche Qualifikation hin ausgewertet. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

#### **Über uns**

Die **Gesellschaft für Informatik e.V. (GI)** gestaltet den digitalen Wandel. Seit 1969 vertritt sie die Interessen der Informatikerinnen und Informatiker in Wissenschaft, Gesellschaft und Politik und setzt sich für eine gemeinwohlorientierte Digitalisierung ein.

title: People Operations Manager (m/f/d) (German-Speaking)
description:
At FORMEL SKIN, part of the VOY family, we're redefining how people access healthcare. Together, we're building one of Europe's leading digital health platforms, helping millions of people improve their health through personalised treatments across dermatology, weight management, and preventative care.

Backed by some of Europe's leading health and consumer investors, FORMEL SKIN and VOY combine medical expertise, technology, and customer-centric innovation to make evidence-based healthcare more accessible, convenient, and effective. To date, we have supported millions of customers and patients through personalised treatment journeys and continue to expand our impact across new health categories.

As a **People Operations Manager (m/f/d)** at FORMEL SKIN / VOY, you will play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient People Operations across our organization. Your primary focus will be on managing HR systems, payroll, and employee lifecycle processes while continuously improving our operational workflows. Leveraging your hands-on HR expertise and interest in AI-driven solutions, you will help build scalable, efficient processes that support our employees and enable our team to focus on what matters most.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* **HR Systems & Optimization:** Play a key role in our migration from Personio to HiBob, from data transfer to workflows and templates, and continue developing the system afterwards. Take ownership of our HR systems, ensuring accurate employee data, efficient workflows, and continuous system improvements to streamline People Operations.
* **Payroll Management:** Support the team to independently coordinate and manage monthly payroll processes, including complex employment arrangements such as working students, mini-jobbers, variable bonuses, , ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
* **Employee Lifecycle & Onboarding:** Manage administrative processes throughout the employee lifecycle, including onboarding workflows, contractual documentation, employee changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth and structured experience.
* **Maternity & Parental Leave Management:** Independently coordinate maternity protection and parental leave processes, ensuring accurate documentation, compliance with German regulations, and reliable support for employees.
* **AI & Process Automation:** Identify opportunities to introduce AI-driven tools and automation into HR workflows, improving efficiency, reducing manual tasks, and creating scalable People processes.
* **People Operations & Collaboration:** Act as a reliable point of contact for operational HR matters, collaborate closely with the People team, and proactively identify opportunities to improve processes and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

**What you need to shine**
--------------------------

* **People Operations Experience:** Proven hands-on experience in People Operations, HR Administration, or a comparable role, ideally within a dynamic startup or scale-up environment.
* **HR Systems Expertise:** Strong experience working with HRsystems, ideally HiBob, including employee data management, system administration, and workflow optimization.
* **Payroll & German HR Knowledge:** Practical experience coordinating payroll for different employment types, combined with a solid understanding of German payroll processes and relevant employment regulations.
* **Employee Lifecycle Expertise:** Experience managing onboarding and HR administration, including maternity protection and parental leave processes under German regulations.
* **AI-Native & Process-Oriented Mindset:** Confidence using AI tools and enthusiasm for implementing automation and improving operational workflows, combined with a structured, detail-oriented, and hands-on approach.
* **Communication & Ownership:** Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, and fluent German and English skills

**Why work with us**
--------------------

* **A great opportunity to develop your People & Culture expertise and knowledge:** You'll work as part of a small, collaborative People & Culture team. Upcoming projects like our HiBob migration give you the chance to learn, take ownership and develop your role over time.
* **Benefits to perfectly fit you:** every candidate is unique, and we're dedicated to supporting your specific needs and aspirations. To support this, we offer a diverse benefits package including 28 days vacation, a NAVIT or Urban Sports Club membership, employee discounts on our products, a personal development budget, flexible working hours & a remote work allowance (4 weeks per year).
* **Building a great team together:** At FORMEL SKIN / VOY, we believe that building a great team and fostering strong interpersonal relationships are fundamental to our success. If you're passionate about collaborating with like-minded individuals, you'll appreciate our approach, which includes regular company events, a team event budget, and bonuses for employee referrals.

title: Sales Manager (Campus & Startup Programs) (f/m/d)
description:
**The Purpose of This Role**

As Sales Manager, you will build and drive our commercial engine with an immediate focus on hands-on sales execution and deal-closing. Working directly alongside the Co-Founder & Managing Director, you’ll build and run the sales funnels across all core products. Once the baseline is set, you will expand into strategic planning and process architecture to scale the revenue engine.

**Location:** Berlin, MotionLab.Berlin, with occasional domestic and international travel  
**Start Date:** asap  
**Seniority:** Mid Level

**About Us**

MotionLab.Berlin is Germany's official Deep Tech Hub and one of Europe's leading hardtech innovation platforms. We support startups, SMEs, and industry leaders in developing and commercialising physical technologies — from first prototype to scale-up.

With 110+ companies and 8 labs on 5,500 m² in Berlin-Alt-Treptow, and ringberlin as our next campus, we are building a bridge from lab to market for the next generation of climate tech, robotics, mobility, and deep tech ventures.

**What You Own**

You expand your scope step by step. In the first six months you drive Campus and Tech Talent sales; once that foundation is strong, Event Space sales and the sales foundation follow.

**1. Campus Sales (MakerGarages, Offices & Memberships)**

* End-to-end startup sales funnel for MakerGarages and Offices across campuses.
* Membership sales to creatives, students, and early-stage startups (online and on-site).
* Lead qualification, campus tours, proposal generation, negotiation, and deal closing.
* Pipeline cleanliness and CRM documentation.
* Smooth member onboarding and handovers to Campus & Community teams.

**2. Tech Talent Program Sales (Tech Challenges for SMEs)**

* Proactive outreach and target identification of SMEs / Mittelstand and innovation units in the DACH region (primarily Germany).
* The full B2B sales cycle: outreach, discovery, scoping, proposal, negotiation, and closing.
* Relationship management to convert initial projects into long-term, recurring partnerships.

**3. Event Space Sales Strategy & Execution**

* Proactive target identification and outreach to potential event clients aligned with our strategic goals.
* Lead conversion and repeat business strategies in collaboration with the Events & Marketing teams.
* Strategic positioning, pricing, and packaging for event spaces, in close collaboration with the Events Manager.

**4. Sales Foundation & Strategy**

* Setup, optimization, and reporting for sales processes and CRM systems.
* Development of core sales collateral and playbooks (templates, scripts, pitch decks).
* Direct feedback loops with Product, Campus, and Program teams to refine product offerings.
* Groundwork and team-building structures to scale the sales department as the business expands.

**Who You Are**

This role is designed for someone with meaningful work experience, who now wants to take real ownership and build something that matters.

**Non-Negotiable**

* Several years of experience (ideally 2–5+ years) in Sales, e.g. in startups, coworking, or B2B services.
* Fluent German (C1+) – you are confident speaking with SMEs and non-startup stakeholders.
* Very good English – our startup ecosystem and community are international.
* Proven track record of owning the full sales cycle: from cold outreach / inbound lead, to needs analysis and proposal, to negotiation and closing.
* Ability to explain complex offers clearly and co-create solutions with customers.
* Comfortable being the first sales person: you don’t wait for a perfect setup – you build it.
* Strategic enough to think about positioning and pricing, and hands-on enough to pick up the phone, follow up and close deals yourself.
* Motivated more by ownership, impact and learning than by a big corporate package.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience working in or closely with the startup ecosystem (ideally Berlin or Germany-wide), plus a network you can activate.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Drive sales at Germany’s Deep Tech Hub:** You come in as our first sales hire and close deals from week one, working directly with our Managing Director. Three products with real demand and a leadership team that works alongside you.
* **Shape how we sell:** We already generate seven-figure revenue; our funnels, pricing and sales collateral are still young. You develop them with us, test what works with real customers and keep what does.
* **Sell what you can touch:** Your customers build sensors, drones, robots and climate tech on our campuses. You walk them through the labs instead of pitching slides, and you see the startups you signed grow next door.
* **Short decision paths, high visibility:** You work closely with leadership, and your output directly shapes the success of our startups and corporate partners.
* **A culture that is honest, learning-oriented, and community-driven:** We celebrate wins, discuss failures openly, and treat feedback as a tool.

**Compensation**

* Base salary: €55,000–€63,000, depending on experience
* Variable: €22,000 at 100 % target achievement, tied to new revenue across Campus, Tech Talent and Events; uncapped above target
* On-target earnings: €77,000–€85,000

**Apply**

**Ready to join us in building the future of deep tech?**

We’d love to hear from you. Apply via the button with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note on why this role is a fit. Questions? Reach out to Fridtjof Gustavs at hiring@motionlab.berlin.
